title: Stripe Checkout
description: One event, one reserve button, a real checkout: a black-and-white supper-club page selling a small-group cooking class — menu card, seats-left scarcity, and a Stripe-backed checkout that is simulated for free in the sandbox and becomes live Stripe on deploy.

theme.$comment: The supper club after hours, preserved verbatim as the seed: a near-black dining room (mode: dark) whose night values are the page's pre-AppShell art constants, so the shell chrome and the room read as one surface; the light values are the same dining room with the lights on. The brand resolves to near-black ink so the reserve button stays deliberately achromatic until a project brands it — the printed menu and reservation cards stay paper-white by art direction in either mode. The shell defaults to minimal because the page is one seller with no navigation; content is flush because the room owns its own container widths.
